definitions.gloss: different kind; different species; different type
definitions.explanation: Something of a different kind or category from what is being compared to. Used in both biological and general contexts.

examples.japanese: {異種|いしゅ}⟦{格闘技|かくとうぎ}→格闘技：09246_kakutougi⟧⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧になった。
examples.english: The mixed martial arts match became a hot topic.

examples.japanese: {異種|いしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}み{合|あ}わせて→組み合わせる：04659_kumiawaseru⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Different types of metals are combined for use.

examples.japanese: {異種|いしゅ}⟦{間|かん}→〜間：28469_kan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{交配|こうはい}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{品種|ひんしゅ}→品種：11840_hinshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: New varieties can be created through cross-breeding between different species.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{異|い}→異：01925_i⟧ (different, other) + ⟦{種|しゅ}→種：28584_shu⟧ (kind, species). Functions both as a standalone noun and as a prefix modifying other nouns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {異種|いしゅ}⟦{格闘技|かくとうぎ}→格闘技：09246_kakutougi⟧: mixed martial arts (fights between different fighting styles)
- {異種|いしゅ}⟦{間|かん}→〜間：28469_kan⟧: between different species/types
- {異種|いしゅ}⟦{混合|こんごう}→混合：04154_kongou⟧: heterogeneous mixture
- {異種|いしゅ}⟦{移植|いしょく}→移植：13761_ishoku⟧: xenotransplantation (transplant from a different species)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{同種|どうしゅ}→同種：23793_doushu⟧: same kind/species — the opposite, indicating things of the same type
- {別種|べっしゅ}: another kind — similar meaning, but used more for classification
- ⟦{異質|いしつ}→異質：13574_ishitsu⟧: heterogeneous, of a different nature — focuses on the quality or nature being different rather than the category
